violations.description: 35 interactive element(s) have outline: none without alternative focus ring or shadow.
No CSS prefers-reduced-motion media query detected in stylesheets.

flaws.description: 14 interactive elements below 44×44px minimum. Primary offenders: Fullscreen button (38×38), checkbox inputs (24×24), skip-link (1×1).
flaws.suggested_fix: Wrap checkbox inputs in label containers with min-h-11 min-w-11 padding. Enlarge fullscreen button. Make skip-link visually accessible with proper sizing.

flaws.description: 35 interactive elements have outline:none with no visible alternative focus ring. Keyboard-only users cannot identify focused element.
flaws.suggested_fix: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 or equivalent to all button/a/input elements via Tailwind global styles.

flaws.description: No prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query. 539 animated elements may cause vestibular distress for motion-sensitive users.
flaws.suggested_fix: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } } to global CSS.

flaws.description: ALL-CAPS eyebrow label 'INITIALIZING SYSTEM' detected — common AI SaaS template chrome.
flaws.suggested_fix: Replace with mixed-case or custom label if it's an intentional status indicator.
